## Support ticket triage (structured output)
POST a ticket to the production webhook:

```
curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook/ticket-triage \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ticket": "I was charged twice this month and your app keeps logging me out. Fix this or I am cancelling."}'
```

The model is forced to answer through one tool with a JSON schema, so the shape is guaranteed. Opening the URL in a browser is a GET and returns 404 on purpose: the node only accepts POST.
